name: Strength
overview: Scripture reveals that true strength comes from the LORD, who is both our protector and source of courage. As Exodus 15:2 declares, God is our strength and salvation, worthy of our exaltation. Believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous without fear because the LORD goes with them and will never forsake them, as emphasized in Deuteronomy 31:6 and Joshua 1:9. Furthermore, God is described as the unchanging Strength of Israel, faithful and reliable beyond human weakness (1 Samuel 15:29), and He strengthens the hearts of those who patiently wait on Him (Psalms 27:14).
